ImageDescription.value: Museum of pharmaceutical history and flats. Built in early Baroque, early 17th century. Transformed in classicist style at the beginning of the 19th century. Slightly transformed, extended towards a courtyard at the end of the 19th century in an eclectic style. Mátyás Herpius has been operating here since 1665 in the Black Szerecseny Pharmacy - 3 Rákóczi Ferenc Street, Kőszeg, Vas County, Hungary.
